messages.author: 6a3b777d6a18967b
messages.subject: Caching / speeding up app
parts:
I have created a shiny app that creates maps:

https://arilamstein.shinyapps.io/choroplethrShiny/
https://github.com/trulia/choroplethrShiny

It is quite slow to load. If I were implementing this project with a web framework that I was familiar with I would simply cache all the images. From the shiny documentation I am not sure how to do that, or if it is even possible - can someone help me with this?

Also, if you select "Admin1" from the dropdown menu that computation seems to time out. However, it takes about 20 seconds on my home machine. I am not sure how to fix that either.

Thanks.

Ari

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Caching / speeding up app
parts:
(cc Fereshteh, Jeff, Winston)

Hmmm, the shinyapps.io app goes grey even if you don't select Admin1, but just sit there for a few seconds. Ari, can you tell us what shinyapps:showLogs() from your local app directory says?

Caching is a little tricky--by default Shiny plots draw themselves to fill their container, so unless two browsers have exactly the same pixel width they couldn't reuse the same plot image. But you can use a fixed plot size if you want, then it's possible to use renderImage/imageOutput to cache plots. See this article under the heading "Sending pre-rendered images with renderImage()".

messages.subject: Re: Caching / speeding up app
parts:
Ari,

The crash (grey out) with Admin1 selection is most likely related to lack of memory. I can see that the memory usage goes pretty high with that selection. You can try increasing the size of your instance on shinyapps.io. Please refer to "Application instances" section in the following document for instructions:

http://shiny.rstudio-staging.com/articles/shinyapps.html


Thanks,
Fereshteh

Ari

On Sun, Dec 21, 2014 at 9:19 AM, Joe Cheng <j...@rstudio.com> wrote:
(cc Fereshteh, Jeff, Winston)

Hmmm, the shinyapps.io app goes grey even if you don't select Admin1, but just sit there for a few seconds. Ari, can you tell us what shinyapps:showLogs() from your local app directory says?

Caching is a little tricky--by default Shiny plots draw themselves to fill their container, so unless two browsers have exactly the same pixel width they couldn't reuse the same plot image. But you can use a fixed plot size if you want, then it's possible to use renderImage/imageOutput to cache plots. See this article under the heading "Sending pre-rendered images with renderImage()".

On Fri, Dec 19, 2014 at 4:36 PM, <arila...@gmail.com> wrote:
I have created a shiny app that creates maps:

https://arilamstein.shinyapps.io/choroplethrShiny/
https://github.com/trulia/choroplethrShiny

It is quite slow to load. If I were implementing this project with a web framework that I was familiar with I would simply cache all the images. From the shiny documentation I am not sure how to do that, or if it is even possible - can someone help me with this?

Also, if you select "Admin1" from the dropdown menu that computation seems to time out. However, it takes about 20 seconds on my home machine. I am not sure how to fix that either.

Thanks.

Ari

On Tue, Dec 23, 2014 at 8:02 AM, Fereshteh Karimeddini <fere...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Ari,

Good to hear that your first problem is resolved.

About the border issue, I am able to see the difference while running your code in different environments. But I cannot yet point to what is actually causing the difference, and how we can fix it. We will look into this and let you know.

Best,
Fereshteh

On Tue, Dec 23, 2014 at 1:11 AM, <arila...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Fereshteh,

Thanks for the tip about memory - that does indeed solve the problem. 

However, I now have another problem - the admin maps that are generating on shinyapps.io are not rendering the actual admin1 borders. This is very different than the images that I get when I run the app locally.

I am attaching the two images. Do you have any idea what could be causing this difference? Looking at size of the files I guess that it might be a resolution issue; if that is the case, how can I get the borders to appear?

If you want to access the code, it is on github here.

Thank you.

Ari

On Mon, Dec 22, 2014 at 8:54 AM, Fereshteh Karimeddini <fere...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Ari,

The crash (grey out) with Admin1 selection is most likely related to lack of memory. I can see that the memory usage goes pretty high with that selection. You can try increasing the size of your instance on shinyapps.io. Please refer to "Application instances" section in the following document for instructions:

http://shiny.rstudio-staging.com/articles/shinyapps.html


Thanks,
Fereshteh


On Sun, Dec 21, 2014 at 2:23 PM, <arila...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks Joe.

I will look into that article now.  Attached is my output from showLogs().

BTW, I see that shiny now supports file upload. When I saw that it occured to me that I might be able to implement all the functionality of choroplethr as a web app (e.g. allow users to upload a file of (region, value) pairs and make a map of it). Do you see any issues with that?

Ari
